claims: The Artemis 2 mission will launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The crewed Orion spacecraft will lift off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Launch Complex 39B is used for Exploration Ground Systems.
Kennedy Space Center is in Merritt Island, Florida.
The Artemis 2 mission is a 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
The Artemis 2 launch is aimed at testing deep space capabilities.
The Artemis 2 launch has viewing opportunities for the public along Florida's Space Coast.
